column1: The environmental practices of big businesses are shaped by a fundamental fact that for many of us offends our sense of justice.
column2: 大企业怎样对待环境，取决于一个基本事实，而我们许多人在道义上都难以接受这个事实。
column3: environmental practices|与环境有关的经营做法
column4: big businesses|大型企业
column7: offends our sense of justice|有悖于我们的正义感

column1: Depending on the circumstances, a business may maximize the amount of money it makes, at least in the short term, by damaging the environment and hurting people.
column2: 视具体情况而定，企业可能通过破坏环境、损害他人利益来赚取最多的钱，至少短期内如此。
column4: circumstances|n. 具体情况
column6: in the short term|在短期内

column1: That is still the case today for fishermen in an unmanaged fishery without quotas, and for international logging companies with short-term leases on tropical rainforest land in places with corrupt officials and unsophisticated landowners.
column2: 今天，在缺乏管理、没有捕捞配额的渔场作业的渔民，仍面临这种情况。在一些官员腐败、土地所有者涉世不深的地方，短期租用热带雨林土地的国际伐木公司也是如此。
column3: still the case|情况仍是如此
column4: unmanaged fishery|无人管理的渔场
column9: unsophisticated landowners|涉世不深的土地所有者

column1: When government regulation is effective, and when the public is environmentally aware, environmentally clean big businesses may out-compete dirty ones, but the reverse is likely to be true if government regulation is ineffective and if the public doesn’t care.
column2: 如果政府监管有效，公众又有环保意识，经营中注重环保的大企业就可能在竞争中胜过那些污染环境的企业。反过来，如果监管不力，公众也漠不关心，结果很可能正好相反。
column4: environmentally aware|有环保意识的

column1: It is easy for the rest of us to blame a business for helping itself by hurting other people.
column2: 对于我们其他人来说，指责一家企业损人利己，是很容易的事。
column3: the rest of us|我们其他人
column4: blame a business|指责一家企业
column6: hurting other people|损害他人利益

column1: But blaming alone is unlikely to produce change.
column2: 但光靠指责很难带来改变。
column4: is unlikely to|不大可能

column1: It ignores the fact that businesses are not charities but profit-making companies, and that publicly owned companies with shareholders are under obligation to those shareholders to maximize profits, provided that they do so by legal means.
column2: 这样的指责忽略了一个事实：企业以营利为目的，并非慈善机构。由公众持股的公司对股东负有义务，要在手段合法的前提下使利润最大化。
column4: profit-making companies|营利性公司
column5: publicly owned companies|公众持股的公司
column9: by legal means|通过合法手段

column1: US laws make a company’s directors legally liable for something termed ‘breach of fiduciary responsibility’ if they knowingly manage a company in a way that reduces profits.
column2: 按美国法律，公司董事如果明知某种经营方式会降低利润而仍按此行事，就要因所谓“违反信义义务”承担法律责任。
column4: legally liable|须承担法律责任的

column1: The car manufacturer Henry Ford was in fact successfully sued by shareholders in 1919 for raising the minimum wage of his workers to $5 per day: the courts declared that, while Ford’s humanitarian sentiments about his employees were nice, his business existed to make profits for its stockholders.
column2: 事实上，汽车制造商亨利·福特因把工人最低工资提高到每天5美元，在1919年遭股东起诉并败诉。法院宣告，福特关怀员工的人道情怀固然可取，但他的企业之所以存在，是为了给股东赚取利润。
column4: successfully sued by shareholders|被股东起诉且股东胜诉

column1: Our blaming of businesses also ignores the ultimate responsibility of the public for creating the conditions that let a business profit through destructive environmental policies.
column2: 我们指责企业的时候还忽略了公众的最终责任：正是公众创造了条件，使企业能够凭借破坏环境的政策获利。
column4: ultimate responsibility|最终责任
column7: destructive environmental policies|破坏环境的政策

column1: In the long run, it is the public, either directly or through its politicians, that has the power to make such destructive policies unprofitable and illegal, and to make sustainable environmental policies profitable.
column2: 从长远看，公众有能力亲自或通过政治代表采取行动，让这些破坏环境的政策既无利可图又成为违法行为，同时让可持续的环境政策变得有利可图。
column3: In the long run|从长远看
column4: either directly or through its politicians|直接或通过政治代表
column7: sustainable environmental policies|可持续的环境政策

column1: The public can do that by suing businesses for harming them, as happened after the Exxon Valdez disaster, in which over 40,000 m³ of oil were spilled off the coast of Alaska.
column2: 公众可以起诉给自己造成伤害的企业。“埃克森·瓦尔迪兹”号油轮事故后就发生过这样的诉讼，那次事故导致逾4万立方米石油泄漏到阿拉斯加近海。
column4: harming them|损害公众自身利益

column1: The public may also make their opinion felt by preferring to buy sustainably harvested products; by making employees of companies with poor track records feel ashamed of their company and complain to their own management; by preferring their governments to award valuable contracts to businesses with a good environmental track record; and by pressing their governments to pass and enforce laws and regulations requiring good environmental practices.
column2: 公众还可以通过购物选择表达意愿，优先购买采用可持续方式采收的产品；也可以使经营记录不佳的企业的员工为自己公司感到羞耻，并向公司管理层反映不满；还可以表示希望政府把价值可观的合同授予环保记录良好的企业，并敦促政府通过并执行法律法规，要求企业采取良好的环保做法。
column3: make their opinion felt|使自己的意见产生影响
column4: sustainably harvested products|以可持续方式采收的产品
column5: poor track records|不良的过往记录
column7: their own management|所在公司的管理层
column8: award valuable contracts|授予价值可观的合同
column9: environmental track record|过往环保记录
column10: pressing their governments|敦促本国政府

column1: In turn, big businesses can exert powerful pressure on any suppliers that might ignore public or government pressure.
column2: 大企业反过来也能对供应商施加强大压力，即使这些供应商原本可能会无视公众或政府的压力。
column4: exert powerful pressure on|对……施加强大压力
column7: public or government pressure|公众或政府的压力

column1: For instance, after the US public became concerned about the spread of a disease known as BSE, which was transmitted to humans through infected meat, the US government’s Food and Drug Administration introduced rules demanding that the meat industry abandon practices associated with the risk of the disease spreading.
column2: 比如，美国公众一度担心牛海绵状脑病（疯牛病）蔓延。这种病曾通过受污染的肉品传给人。随后，美国食品药品监督管理局颁布规定，要求肉类行业停止那些有疾病传播风险的做法。
column4: the spread of a disease|疾病的蔓延
column8: Food and Drug Administration|美国食品药品监督管理局
column11: the risk of the disease spreading|疾病传播的风险

column1: But for five years the meat packers refused to follow these, claiming that they would be too expensive to obey.
column2: 但肉类加工企业连续五年拒绝遵守这些规定，声称合规成本太高。
column4: meat packers|肉类加工企业
column7: too expensive to obey|遵规成本过高

column1: However, when a major fast-food company then made the same demands after customer purchases of its hamburgers plummeted, the meat industry complied within weeks.
column2: 然而，当一家大型快餐公司在汉堡销量暴跌后也提出同样的要求时，肉类行业在几周内就照办了。
column3: major fast-food company|大型快餐公司
column4: made the same demands|提出同样的要求

column1: The public’s task is therefore to identify which links in the supply chain are sensitive to public pressure: for instance, fast-food chains or jewelry stores, but not meat packers or gold miners.
column2: 因此，公众需要识别出供应链中哪些环节对公众压力敏感。例如，连锁快餐店和珠宝店会作出反应，肉类加工企业和采金企业对这种压力却不敏感。
column4: links in the supply chain|供应链中的环节

column1: Some readers may be disappointed or outraged that I place the ultimate responsibility for business practices harming the public on the public itself.
column2: 我认为，企业的做法损害了公众，最终责任却在公众自己。这也许会让一些读者失望，甚至愤怒。
column4: outraged|adj. 愤慨的
column5: place the ultimate responsibility|把最终责任归于

column1: I also believe that the public must accept the necessity for higher prices for products to cover the added costs, if any, of sound environmental practices.
column2: 我也认为，如果良好的环保做法确实增加了成本，公众就必须接受产品需要涨价以弥补这些成本。
column3: accept the necessity|接受其必要性
column4: higher prices|更高的价格
column5: cover the added costs|弥补额外成本
column6: if any|如果确有这些成本
column7: sound environmental practices|妥善的环保做法

column1: My views may seem to ignore the belief that businesses should act in accordance with moral principles even if this leads to a reduction in their profits.
column2: 我的看法似乎忽略了一种信念：即使会导致利润下降，企业也应遵循道德原则行事。
column4: ignore the belief|忽略这一信念
column8: a reduction in their profits|利润的减少

column1: But I think we have to recognize that, throughout human history, in all politically complex human societies, government regulation has arisen precisely because it was found that not only did moral principles need to be made explicit, they also needed to be enforced.
column2: 但我认为，我们必须承认，在整个人类历史上，凡是政治结构复杂的社会，都出现了政府监管。原因恰恰在于，人们发现道德原则既需要明确表述，也需要得到强制执行。
column3: throughout human history|纵观人类历史
column4: politically complex|政治结构复杂的

column1: To me, the conclusion that the public has the ultimate responsibility for the behavior of even the biggest businesses is empowering and hopeful, rather than disappointing.
column2: 在我看来，即使是最大企业的行为，公众也负有最终责任。这个结论让人感到自己有力量，也给人希望，并不令人失望。
column4: behavior|n. 行为
column5: even the biggest businesses|甚至最大的企业
column6: empowering|adj. 使人感到有力量的

column1: My conclusion is not a moralistic one about who is right or wrong, admirable or selfish, a good guy or a bad guy.
column2: 我的结论无意作道德评判，不在于断定谁对谁错、谁值得钦佩谁自私、谁是好人谁是坏人。
column4: right or wrong|对或错
column7: a good guy or a bad guy|好人或坏人

column1: In the past, businesses have changed when the public came to expect and require different behavior, to reward businesses for behavior that the public wanted, and to make things difficult for businesses practicing behaviors that the public didn’t want.
column2: 过去，当公众开始期待并要求企业改变做法，奖赏采取了公众所期待做法的企业，又让坚持公众不认可做法的企业日子不好过时，企业也就作出了改变。
column4: require different behavior|要求改变行为
column6: make things difficult for|使……处境艰难

column1: I predict that in the future, just as in the past, changes in public attitudes will be essential for changes in businesses’ environmental practices.
column2: 我预计，未来也会像过去一样，公众态度的转变将是企业改变环境行为的必要条件。
column4: just as in the past|正如过去一样
column6: be essential for|是……的必要条件
column7: environmental practices|与环境有关的经营做法
